mission.title: Why we build
mission.manifesto:
Small consistent actions, stacked over time, create big results.
Like **stacking sats**. Like **stacking blocks**. That's **BitByBit**.
mission.value2: **Collaboration** over competition. With the community, not against it.
mission.value3: **Open** over closed. Public code, documented decisions.

projects.title: What we're building
projects.subtitle:
Three real apps, shipped at La Crypta hackathons.
Try them and let us know what you think.
projects.habitsTagline: Family habit tracker with sat rewards over Lightning.
projects.habitsStory: Habits turns 'la mesada' (the kid's allowance) into a tool for financial education. Parents assign habits with sat rewards; kids complete them and receive real Bitcoin instantly via Lightning. Mesada 2.0.
projects.arenaTagline: Public challenges on Nostr — identity, proofs and zaps.
projects.arenaStory: Arena started as a New Year's resolution experiment inside La Crypta — a few of us wanted to improve our habits and share progress by tagging each other on Nostr. Today it's that same loop turned into an app: any Nostr identity can create challenges, join, and earn NIP-58 badges that travel across Nostr clients.
projects.arenaHighlight2: **NIP-58 badges** · Achievements that travel with you
projects.cursatsTagline: Lightning checkout for teachers — buyers pay in sats, you choose how to get paid.
projects.cursatsStory: CURSATS turns any class or course into a Lightning checkout. Buyers always pay in sats; the seller picks how the money arrives — pesos to a CBU via Wapu, or sats to a Lightning Address.
projects.cursatsHighlight1: **Two payout rails** · Pesos via Wapu or sats to your wallet
projects.cursatsHighlight2: **Buyers pay in sats** · You choose how to get paid
projects.cursatsHighlight3: **Built for educators** · Teachers, tutors and academies
